entry.title: New: Bill 140, CD1 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, REVENUES; AND DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE, COUNTYWIDE COSTS" The purpose of this bill is to 1) increase Carryover/Savings in the General Fund and Total Estimated Revenues by $10,000,000; and 2) amend Department of Finance, Countywide Costs by increasing the appropriation for Insurance Programs and Self Insurance, Category B - Operations and Equipment and Total in the amount of $10,000,000 and increase the Total Operating Appropriations and Total Appropriations by the same amount.
